title: JUKI LK-1900BN
subtitle: Computer-Controlled High-Speed Bartacking Machine
overviewDescription: The JUKI LK-1900BN is a computerized bartacking machine. It makes a short and strong reinforcement stitch by combining normal lockstitch formation with electronic X-Y movement of the work clamp. The needle goes up and down, the hook catches the thread loop, and the fabric is moved automatically by the machine according to the selected bartack pattern.

classificationTable.value: Reinforcement bartack sewing on pocket corners, belt-loop areas, straps, labels, knit garments, heavy garments

technicalSpecs.value: Standard semi-rotary hook; W type uses large hook

workingPrinciples.heading: 1. Lockstitch Formation
workingPrinciples.description: The needle carries the upper thread through the fabric. The semi-rotary hook catches the upper-thread loop and joins it with the bobbin thread. The work clamp moves the fabric in X and Y directions controlled electronically to create different bartack shapes.

workingPrinciples.heading: 2. Direct-Drive Servo Motor
workingPrinciples.description: A compact AC servo motor drives the main sewing shaft directly, providing precise speed control and instant start/stop capability for high-speed bartacking operations.

workingPrinciples.heading: 3. Electronic X-Y Feed
workingPrinciples.description: Two stepping motors control the X and Y axes of the work clamp, moving the fabric according to digitally stored pattern data. This eliminates the need for manual fabric movement during sewing.

workingPrinciples.heading: 4. Active Tension Control
workingPrinciples.description: The active tension system electronically controls thread tension according to sewing conditions, ensuring consistent stitch quality across varying material thicknesses and pattern shapes.

maintenance.definition: Incorrect tension, worn needle, dirty hook area
maintenance.action: Check thread path, replace needle, clean hook/shuttle area

maintenance.definition: Wrong needle size, incorrect timing, fabric obstruction
maintenance.action: Replace needle, check hook timing, verify clamp position
Clean trimming area, sharpen or replace moving/counter knife

maintenance.definition: Corrupted pattern data, origin sensor failure
maintenance.action: Reload pattern, inspect X/Y/clamp origin sensors
Check encoder cable, ensure proper ventilation, verify power supply

maintenance.definition: Incorrect tension, dirty bobbin case, hook timing off
maintenance.action: Adjust tension, clean bobbin case, re-time hook/needle

finalNotes:
• The LK-1900BN is not only a fast sewing machine. Its real production performance depends on machine speed, operator handling time, clamp position, thread condition, needle condition, hook/shuttle cleanliness, thread trimming condition, and correct pattern setting.
• If one garment needs 6 bartacks and total observed time is 20–23 seconds, then the practical average is about 3.3–3.8 seconds per bartack including operator handling.
• Model Subclasses: S = Standard, H = Heavy-weight, F = Foundation, M = Knits, W = Heavy with large hook, B/BNB = Bird's nest preventing.
